summary_md: **Jae Kwon ([@jaekwon](https://x.com/jaekwon/status/2114984934305845305))** says that in his own local testing with simple prompts, **Qwen3.8-27B** came across as clearly smarter than **GPT-OSS-120B**, and that this already seems to be common knowledge. He links an opencode.ai comparison page (Qwen3.8 27B vs GPT OSS Safeguard 120B).

referenced_urls.title: Qwen3.8 27B vs GPT OSS Safeguard 120B - AI Model Comparison

relevance: A practitioner data point that the ~27–30B Qwen tier can outperform a much larger open model, useful when choosing between the mid and max tiers on a Spark.
